items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 30:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Daat of ZA? The Daat of ZA has in it MAH and BAN, for its right side is drawn from the right shoulder of AA, which is from the general MAH, and its left side, which is the crown of Gevura, is drawn from the left shoulder of AA, which is from the general BAN. And although after the Nesira ZA remains entirely Hesed, and the Nukva is entirely Gevura, nevertheless the root of the Gevurot remains in ZA, namely his crown of Gevura, which is the aspect of the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, which are BAN. And the entire aspect of the GAR of the Nukva is from the force of the illumination of the root of the Gevurot that remained in ZA, namely the crown of Gevura. (Item 158).
